name: gws-new-user-provisioning

trigger.trigger_note: Polling trigger — fires when a new Google Workspace user is created. Polling triggers never backfill: the watermark is set on activation, so users created while this workflow is disabled are missed (the classic Zap covers that window until cutover).

connections.note: No workflow-body connections. The trigger's Google Workspace Admin connection is bound in the trigger config above; Zapier Tables, Zapier Manager (team_invite) and Email by Zapier all run on built-in account auth.

tables.01JM3J9SG5X6S8GBSSC8AS28AT: [Table] Internal User IDs — find-or-create by Email (f2); reads Zapier ID (f7) to decide whether to send the Zapier team invite; seeds First Name (f13) / Last Name (f14) on create only. The five internal-user-ids-* durables key on the same Email column, and internal-user-ids-zapier is what writes Zapier ID back once the invite is accepted.

replaces_classic_zap: New Google Workspace Account -> Provision Standard Accounts

cutover.classic_zap_disabled: 2026-08-14 — confirmed by Dennis. Not machine-verifiable: classic Zaps are exposed by neither the SDK CLI nor the MCP connector
cutover.durable_enabled: 2026-08-14 — enabled by Dennis (verified via get-workflow: enabled true, trigger active)
cutover.status: complete — this durable is the only provisioning flow. Harvest/Linear auto-provisioning explicitly deferred (Dennis, 2026-08-14): keep them manual for now

description: New Google Workspace user -> Internal User IDs Table row (find-or-create by email), Zapier team invite when the row has no Zapier ID yet, welcome email with the Slack/Notion SSO join links.
